etymology: 古い英語 rēad(赤) → 赤 → (怒り・はずかしさで)顔が赤い → 赤字(in the red)

en_definitions.text: having the color of blood or fire; (of a face) pink because of anger or embarrassment.
the color red; (in the red) owing money.

cautions: in the red=赤字で(⇔in the black=黒字で)
catch A red-handed=Aを現行犯でつかまえる

patterns.meaning: Aを現行犯でつかまえる
